title: Dynamic Cross-Modal Prompt Generation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2605.10765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world deployment often requires continual capability expansion across sequential tasks. In such scenarios, Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) aims to acquire new capabilities while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods mainly follow a module-composition paradigm: they maintain task-level prompts or LoRA experts and dynamically route or aggregate a subset of them at inference. However, samples within the same task can still differ substantially in visual scenes, question intents, and reasoning demands. This motivates instance-level adaptation to individual query-image pairs rather than only selecting or combining task-level modules. To this end, we propose DRAPE (Dynamic Cross-Modal Prompt Generation), a prompt-learning framework that synthesizes continuous instance-specific soft prompts for MCIT. Ins

translated_title: 面向多模态持续指令微调的动态跨模态提示生成
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型通过指令微调获得了强大的性能，然而实际部署往往需要在序列任务中持续扩展能力。在这种场景下，多模态持续指令微调旨在获取新能力的同时限制灾难性遗忘。现有方法主要遵循模块组合范式：它们维护任务级提示或LoRA专家，并在推理时动态路由或聚合其中的一个子集。然而，同一任务内的样本在视觉场景、问题意图和推理需求上仍可能存在显著差异。这促使我们对每个查询-图像对进行实例级适应，而不仅仅是选择或组合任务级模块。为此，我们提出了DRAPE（动态跨模态提示生成），这是一个为多模态持续指令微调合成连续的实例特定软提示的提示学习框架。
tldr: 提出DRAPE框架，通过动态生成实例特定的跨模态软提示，实现针对每个查询-图像对的个性化适应，从而在多模态持续指令微调中缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: DRAPE dynamically synthesizes instance-specific cross-modal soft prompts for multimodal continual instruction tuning, enabling adaptation to individual query-image pairs and mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
